name: Kunisaki Amane
source:
1st year high school student.
The protagonist's younger brother.
A glasses wearing genius type.
A kind little brother who always puts his family first.
He's extremely protective of his sister.
[spoiler]Has a non-romantic ending.[/spoiler]
